notes: Both documents (UWM Guidance page, CASL syllabus-statement page) were coded by both coders; all 34 of A's units matched a B unit. B found 8 extra real units (separate sentences or facts that A folded into neighbouring units), all kept. Main disagreements: (1) document stance of the Guidance page (A delegates, B permit): resolved to permit because the page sets conditions for use and does not hand the decision to instructors; (2) policy type for framing sentences (P44 vs P56, P56 vs P116, P77 vs P74), resolved by the heading and wording of each passage; (3) the prohibit-template sentence on partial assistance (P105 vs P19), resolved to P19 with a fit_note; (4) unit_stance on citation duties (require vs neutral), resolved to permit where the duty conditions permitted use in a template; (5) minor phase/modality differences (before-course vs course-start/general, should vs must on a checklist, informs vs must-not on a quoted definition). Shares are over matched units.
